description: A failed call in the result that isn't selected takes no part in unifying the results
notes: The spec says errors in the result that isn't selected aren't passed through, and that both results must unify, but not what type a failed result has; the function would return a bool, which doesn't unify with a number. hashicorp/hcl evaluates both results (ConditionalExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go) and gets the dynamic value from the failed call, as from any failed call (FunctionCallExpr.Value); because one result has the dynamic pseudo-type, it skips unification and returns the selected number unconverted. A failed !nope still yields a bool, so unification fails there (native/operators/conditional-unselected-error-still-unified).
